##### AGA-8 Compounds in the Hydrocarbon Properties Editor 

The AGA-8 compounds option has been removed from the Hydrocarbon Properties Editor.  
<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="AGA-8 Compounds">

|  |  |
|:---|:---|
| Reason | The AGA-8 Compounds option in the Hydrocarbon Properties Editor did not work as intended. It was introduced in a prior version but was not widely adopted by the user community. |
| Replaced by Another Feature | No |
| Items Affected | Navigate to Setup \> Source Analysis \> Hydrocarbon Properties. The AGA-8 option was located in the Compounds group box. |
| Installation Changes | N/A |
| Upgrade Changes | N/A |

</div>

##### Merging Batches in Volume Editor with Product Filtering on

Batch merging in the Volume Editor, when product filtering is on, is no longer available.  
<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Merging Batches">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Show Details</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Merging Batches">

|  |  |
|:---|:---|
| Reason | If batches exist on a meter for different products and you use the Product drop-down (Volume Editor \> Batch tab) to filter to one product, you can’t see where you have batches or virtual batches with other products in between. Trying to merge batches when product filtering is on under these conditions can cause unintended results. |
| Replaced by Another Feature | No. Merging batches will continue to be supported when product filtering is off. |
| Items Affected | Merging batches in the Volume Editor Batch tab with product filtering on. |
| Installation Changes | N/A |
| Upgrade Changes | N/A |

</div>

##### Date Options on Balance Breakout Report

The Contract Day(s) and Date/Time Range date options for the Balance Breakout report have been removed. The report now runs for a Contract Month.  
<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Date Options">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Show Details</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Date Options">

|  |  |
|:---|:---|
| Reason | Running the Balance Breakout report for Contract Day(s) or Date/Time Range forces the report to calculate the total inlet and outlet values in the report, rather than reporting from the FLOWCAL database, because the totals may not be available in the database depending on the date range selected. This can affect report accuracy and performance. |
| Replaced by Another Feature | The Balance Breakout report will continue to be available with the Contract Month option. |
| Items Affected | Balance Breakout report; the report now runs for a Contract Month |
| Installation Changes | N/A |
| Upgrade Changes | If you have a report schedule that runs the Balance Breakout report for anything other than Contract Month, the report schedule will need to be updated. |

</div>

##### Log Validation Set Point History

The Log Validation Set Point History option has been removed from the FLOWCAL Configuration screen.  
<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Log Validation">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Show Details</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Log Validation">

|  |  |
|:---|:---|
| Reason | When the Log Validation Set Point History option is enabled (FLOWCAL Configuration), and a user edits the validation set points, the change is documented within the validation history. Enabling this option in order to use this functionality was not intuitive for customers. This option has been removed, and the validation history will always be tracked. |
| Replaced by Another Feature | No. Changes to validations are always logged now. |
| Items Affected | FLOWCAL Configuration \> Log Validation Set Point History option |
| Installation Changes | N/A |
| Upgrade Changes | N/A |

</div>

##### Print Button on Exception Resolver

The Print button has been removed from the Exception Resolver screen.  
<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Print Button">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Show details</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Print Button">

|  |  |
|:---|:---|
| Reason | FLOWCAL 10.0.1 introduces a new and improved Exception Resolver. Feedback from our working group showed that most users did not use the Print button from the Exception Resolver to run the Exceptions report. |
| Replaced by Another Feature | Yes. The new Exception Resolver offers an Export to Excel feature. |
| Items Affected | The Exception Resolver no longer includes a Print button to run the Exceptions report. A new toolbar button is now available to export exception data to Excel. |
| Installation Changes | N/A |
| Upgrade Changes | N/A |

</div>

##### \[ALL\] Object on Exception Resolver

The \[ALL\] option has been removed from the object selector for the Exception Resolver.  
<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="All Option">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Show details</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="All Option">

|  |  |
|:---|:---|
| Reason | FLOWCAL 10.0.1 introduces a new and improved Exception Resolver with a new object selector. The object selector no longer includes the \[ALL\] option in order to prevent users from unintentionally loading an excessive amount of exceptions and reduce code complexity. |
| Replaced by Another Feature | No; however, users can create a list containing all objects such as meters, sources, or locations, to perform the same function. |
| Items Affected | The Exception Resolver no longer includes the \[ALL\] option within the object selector. |
| Installation Changes | N/A |
| Upgrade Changes | N/A |

</div>

</div>

##### FcBatch

The FcBatch utility has been removed from FLOWCAL and is no longer supported. The service login has been removed from the Service Configuration screen along with all internal logic.  
<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Utilities">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Show Details</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Utilities">

|  |  |
|:---|:---|
| Reason | The FcBatch utility was written before a standard File Import service was available. The File Import service now comes standard with FLOWCAL Enterprise and Client/Server. It was also used for scheduling exports for customers without the Report Scheduling module. |
| Replaced by Another Feature | Yes. This functionality is available with the File Import service and Report Scheduler service. |
| Items Affected | FcBatch.exe |
| Installation Changes | The FcBatch utility has been removed from the FLOWCAL installer and is no longer supported. |
| Upgrade Changes | N/A |

</div>
